I've answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

That comes from Priyanka's messages in that channel on 2025-09-03. Her first post said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her closing note at 18:43 said "Southgate cleared the backlog."

The shared files have no Tansley account folder, so I couldn't give him a full address for the site. I suggested he ask Priyanka if he needs more detail. Tobias is a member of that channel, so I only used what he can already see there.
